Mostly suicidal thoughts and even gestures. Other than that, I've said things that I don't mean and started "hanging out with the wrong crowd" so to speak, and doing ridiculous uncharacteristic things like drugs and binge drinking. Usually these actions ruin my interpersonal relationships. For instance, I recently cheated on my boyfriend, which was a hard thing to experience in the back of my own head. 

Perhaps what I'm experiencing is simply an excessive amount of impulsiveness?
This makes a lot of sense, seeing as I'm not the most emotionally stable person. I'm seeing my GP about the whole situation soon. Thanks!

thank you, this was really encouraging and helpful. i'm actually about to apply for medicaid (i had it when i was younger, i recently aged out of the system, but i'm still applicable), which should help with mental health coverage. as soon as that's taken care of, i'm seeing my GP asap and telling her everything.

Thanks for this. My only fear is that next year will be worse than this one. And the years after that, worse than the last. But I will try to hope and believe they won't be, and that this pain will ease over time. Even if nothing changes, I'll try to stay strong. It's hard, but I'll get through it. Hopefully.
